deviation.name: Fissure Cascade
deviation.description: Fissures rip into the mission, causing the Enemy Level to go up by 1 every 10s. Destroy them to stop the level from increasing further.

risks.name: Bolstered Belligerents
risks.description: All enemies have Overguard equal to 50% of their max health.

risks.name: Entanglement
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies endure reduced Movement Speed and Parkour Velocity.

deviation.name: Parasitic Towers
deviation.description: Life Support Towers only activate after 20 enemies have been killed within a 15m radius of them.

risks.name: Devil's Bargain
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies gain 25% Fire Rate at the cost of -50% Ammo Efficiency.

deviation.name: Eroding Senses
deviation.description: The Auricle and Vitreum take damage over time, collecting the required Vosphene Glyphs will halt the degradation and partially heal them.

risks.name: Fortified Foes
risks.description: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.

personalModifiers.name: Undersupplied
personalModifiers.description: Max ammo on all weapons reduced by 75%

personalModifiers.name: Transference Distortion
personalModifiers.description: Transference into Operator and Drifter is blocked.

personalModifiers.name: Framecurse syndrome
personalModifiers.description: Activating an Ability inflicts 50 damage upon you.

deviation.name: Sealed Armor
deviation.description: Enemies take 90% less damage from non-Weak Point hits.

risks.name: Arcade Automate
risks.description: Enemy guns launch large, slow moving orbs instead of their usual ordnance.

risks.name: It's Alive
risks.description: Within the underground, hostile overgrowths will attack if players stops moving.

deviation.name: Vampire Rock
deviation.description: Flare creates a field that disrupts player abilities while draining energy to boost Flare's health. Flare slowly loses health when no players are in range.

risks.name: Balloonfest
risks.description: Scaldra Harbingers are more numerous and attack and move more quickly.

risks.name: Vampyric Liminus
risks.description: Slow moving, immortal, Duviri Liminus drain health and energy from allies who get too close.

deviation.name: Toxic Tank
deviation.description: The tank has a Toxin aura, leaves Toxin trails, and its attacks all deal Toxin damage.

risks.name: Scaldra Speed Run
risks.description: All enemies are replaced with Scaldra and move much faster.

personalModifiers.name: Energy Exhaustion
personalModifiers.description: Lose 2 Energy per second for each enemy within 10 meters of you.

personalModifiers.name: Dropped Guard
personalModifiers.description: Warframe and ally Overguard gain reduced by 75%.
